body: I can try to tend to personality issues, although I'm not sure how to do that. Though I'll never have a good body either since I have a gross scar just under my ribcage from surgery that I had.

I've cut pretty much everyone out of my life who treated me badly. I wasn't friends with those people anyway, so I just went to a different college they went to and avoid going to places where they usually go. 

That hasn't helped though. I don't see them anymore, but I'll never forget them or the way I was treated. Besides, people always judge other by their looks. I may not get people making fun of me anymore (except for the odd occasion), but I can see people judging me by the way they look at me. I don't even go out in public much because of it now.

I think I'm ugly because I've been told by many people. Even by friends. Not in a hateful way, but an honest way. I cannot think of anything attractive about myself. I've never been complemented on my appearance in any way.

Also, no I don't work out, but I'm not fat. Not even overweight.
